description: Conformance vectors generated by Alloy from docs/formal/conformance.als (model: mandate.als). check=subset: isMandateSubset(parent, child) == expected; check=allows: checkAction(child, query).allowed == expected; check=delegated: the child is contained in the parent and allows the query, so checkAction(parent, query).allowed must be true; check=issue (D-37): buildDelegation from a credential with the parent mandate to the child mandate succeeds == expected (fields the model leaves out, and that neither mandate sets, are filled in the child with values that cannot change the answer).
